description.value: The Sointula Branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library is a small public library serving the community of Sointula on Malcolm Island, accessible only by BC Ferries from Port McNeill. Opened in 1990 and renovated in 2003, it features a cozy reading nook and is part of the broader VIRL network spanning Vancouver Island and the central BC coast. For cyclists touring this remote island, it offers a quiet public space with free WiFi and public computers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully loaded and confirms the Sointula branch is active, listing branch features including 'Free public WiFi,' '2 public access computers,' 'Photocopying,' 'Youth area,' and 'Wheelchair accessible.' No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, showers, cafe, or any bike-specific amenities appears in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active public library on remote Malcolm Island offering free WiFi; a useful stop for touring cyclists on this ferry-accessed island with limited services.
enrichment_extras.notes: Professional staff are stationed at the Port Hardy branch; the Sointula branch operates with limited on-site staffing.

blurb: Small public library in ferry-access Sointula, open since 1990.
